_doc: The events of the live road (round 21, scripts/drive/road_events.gd). An event: title and text (the card and the banner); kind (dead: the dead come at you; stop: someone or something at the verge, a card; block: wrecks across the road; forced: the car stops by itself); weight (relative chance; dead kinds grow with the place's danger, `hp_weight` kinds with the car's wear); legs (there, home); vehicle (any, needs: a vehicle only, foot: on foot only); min_danger; band (any, day, night: by the hour of its slot on the road); needs (bed, seat, fuel_room, vehicle: the base's and the car's state); card (always, vehicle: only with a vehicle, never: nothing is asked, the choice happens by itself); auto (the choice the card takes when it is not answered, and the choice a card-less event happens as), auto_else (what the card takes if auto is refused), timeout (auto: the card takes the auto choice after ttl_s seconds; close: it just closes). A choice: id, label, needs (seat, bed, vehicle, fuel_room, stock:<name>:<n>, toll:<n>), effects, lines (what the squad says: two of them are used), log (the radio's line: text and sub), and optionally maybe {chance, effects, lines}, one_of [{needs, effects, lines, log}] (one is taken by the dice), gamble {base, skill, per, cap, win {effects, lines, log}, lose {effects, lines, log}}. Effects (all optional): stock {food|water|scrap|meds|ammo: n | [lo, hi], two_of: {from, base, per_danger}, toll: {n, mult, from}} (positive: into the party's bags, it comes home; negative: paid from the base's stock now), fuel, vehicle_hp, hp_all, hurt (scratch | bite), trust, morale, survivor, reveal (near), stop_s (n | {base, skill, per, min}), dead {walker|runner|brute: [lo, hi], grow: {kind: per danger point}, from: {kind: first danger it comes at}, where, state}, block_cleared. In lines and logs: {n} the dead, {loot}, {fuel}, {who}, {paid}, {secs}.

ambush.title: Ambush!
ambush.text: The dead come out of the verges on both sides, just ahead.

choices.label: Drive through or fight
lines: Both sides! Here they come!
Foot down, or stop and shoot: your call.
Heads in. Heads IN.

log.text: An ambush on the road: {n} of the dead came out of the verges.
log.sub: The squad is watching the road.

roadblock.title: Roadblock
roadblock.text: Wrecks across the road with one gap. Thread it, ram a wreck, or stop and clear it.

choices.label: Clear it
lines: Get the chains. Keep your eyes open.
We drag them aside. Somebody watch the verges.

log.text: The squad dragged the wrecks off the road.
log.sub: {n} of the dead came while they worked.

survivor.title: Someone is waving
survivor.text: A person stands at the verge with both arms up.

choices.label: Take them in
lines: Get in. Quick. There is a bed for you at the base.
{who} climbs in without a word.

log.text: {who} was taken in on the road.
log.sub: There is a bed for them at the base.

choices.label: Drive on
lines: We can't stop for everyone.
They get smaller in the mirror.

log.text: The squad drove past a survivor on the road.

wreck_supplies.title: A wreck by the road
wreck_supplies.text: A car on its side with the boot sprung open and full.

choices.label: Search it

lines: Something was in the back seat!
Boot's full. Quick, before anything smells us.
Two on the boot, two on the road.

log.text: The squad searched a wreck and found {loot}.

choices.label: Drive on
lines: Not worth it.
Another wreck. The road is full of them.

log.text: The squad drove past a wreck.

breakdown.title: Puncture
breakdown.text: A bang, and the car pulls to one side and coasts to a stop.

choices.label: Fix it
lines: Spare's in the back. Everybody out.
Hold the jack. Hold your breath.

log.text: A tyre went on the road: the squad changed it in {secs} seconds.

herd.title: A herd on the road
herd.text: Dozens of the dead stand in the road ahead, shoulder to shoulder, and do not look up.

choices.label: Plough through, go round or shoot
lines: Look at them all. Don't wake them.
That is a whole street standing there.
Slow and wide, or fast and straight. Decide.

log.text: A herd of {n} of the dead stands on the road.
log.sub: They have not noticed anyone yet.

fuel_stash.title: Drums on the verge
fuel_stash.text: Fuel drums stacked against the cab of a tanker at the verge.

choices.label: Siphon it
lines: Hose. Bucket. Don't spill it.
That tanker never made it home either.

log.text: The squad siphoned {fuel} fuel from a tanker.
log.sub: It goes into the base's tank.

choices.label: Drive on
lines: No time for it.
Leave it for the next one.

log.text: The squad drove past a tanker's fuel drums.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.text: A barrier of cars and sandbags. Armed survivors watch you come, and one holds up a hand.

choices.label: Pay the toll
lines: Ten of whatever. Pay them.
They count it twice and wave you through.

log.text: The squad paid {paid} to pass a checkpoint.

choices.label: Trade

lines: Twenty scrap, and they pour us eight fuel.
Fair is fair. Fill her up.

log.text: The squad traded 20 scrap for 8 fuel at a checkpoint.
log.sub: It goes into the base's tank.

lines: Twenty scrap for three of their meds.
They don't ask where we got it.

log.text: The squad traded 20 scrap for 3 meds at a checkpoint.
log.sub: The meds are in the bags.

lines: Twenty scrap on the table.
Show them what we have.

log.text: The squad traded with a checkpoint.

choices.label: Talk

lines: They listened. They even told us what is on the road ahead.
Free pass. Don't look surprised.

log.text: The squad talked its way past a checkpoint.
log.sub: They were told of a place nearby.

lines: That did it. They want twice the toll.
Somebody got a rifle butt in the ribs.

log.text: A checkpoint would not listen and took double the toll.

lines: Hands where they can see them. Let me talk.

log.text: The squad talked to a checkpoint.

choices.label: Run it
lines: Floor it! Floor it!
Get down! Get DOWN!

log.text: The squad ran a checkpoint.
log.sub: They shot at the car as it went.

smoke.title: Smoke and a chalk sign
smoke.text: A column of smoke over the roofs, and a chalked arrow on the road: people this way.

choices.label: Check it

lines: Something is coming out of the smoke!
The chalk is fresh. Somebody was here today.
Five minutes. Not one more.

log.text: The squad followed a chalked sign off the road.

choices.label: Drive on
lines: Smoke means people. People mean trouble.
Not today.

log.text: The squad drove past a column of smoke.

night_road.title: Night on the road
night_road.text: The light goes. The headlights make a small room in the dark, and the dead are about.
lines: Lights on. Eyes open.
Nobody should be out on this road after dark.

log.text: The road home is dark now.
log.sub: The dead are about in greater numbers at night.
